faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email address, and follow the instructions sent to your email.

faqs.question: Why is the page not loading?
faqs.answer: This could be due to internet connectivity issues, server problems, or browser cache. Try refreshing the page, clearing your browser cache, or checking your internet connection.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can contact support through the 'Contact Us' page, email support@company.com, or use the live chat feature if available.

faqs.question: How do I save my progress?
faqs.answer: Most forms auto-save your progress. Look for 'Save Draft' buttons or ensure you're logged in for automatic saving.

faqs.question: What browsers are supported?
faqs.answer: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For best experience, please keep your browser updated.

faqs.question: How do I enable microphone access?
faqs.answer: Click the microphone icon in your browser's address bar and select 'Allow'. You may need to refresh the page after granting permission.

faqs.question: Can I use this on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, our voice assistant works on mobile devices. Make sure to allow microphone access when prompted.

faqs.question: How do I share my screen?
faqs.answer: Click the screen share button and select the window or screen you want to share. Your browser will ask for permission first.
